prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] Emoji · 赛事结果 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "排名" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 27px
  col 2: header "国家/地区" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 73px
  col 3: header "🥇" · longest unbreakable word 17px · one-line width 17px
  col 4: header "🥈" · longest unbreakable word 17px · one-line width 17px
  col 5: header "🥉" · longest unbreakable word 17px · one-line width 17px
  col 6: header "亮点" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 232px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示各国家或地区的赛事奖牌成绩及表现亮点。","reading":"读者先按排名浏览国家或地区，再横向比较金、银、铜牌数，并阅读每行的亮点。","groups":["排名与国家/地区共同标识每一行。","🥇、🥈、🥉是并列的奖牌数量列，应保持一致的视觉节奏。","亮点是对同一行成绩的文字补充。"],"keep_intact":["排名数字、奖牌数字和奖牌图标","国家或地区名称及其旗帜，尽量保持在同一行"],"may_wrap":["亮点中的中文短句可自然换行；较长的亮点可以利用同一行增加的高度完整呈现。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [48, 94, 41, 41, 41, 214] · table 480×207px · row heights [33, 53, 53, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [45, 85, 39, 39, 39, 232] · table 480×227px · row heights [53, 33, 53, 33, 53] · column headers wrapped 1/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [48, 110, 48, 48, 48, 177] · table 480×207px · row heights [33, 53, 53, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"排名和国家/地区清楚地标识各行；三列奖牌宽度一致，便于横向比较。表头和国家名称均保持完整，亮点也有较充足的空间。","problems":"首行亮点末尾的跑步图标单独落到第二行，形成很短的尾行；第二行亮点也需要换行。","cause":"亮点列为214px，扣除内边距和边框后文字空间不足以容纳首行完整内容。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"亮点列较宽，首行亮点与图标保持在一行；奖牌列等宽，数字易于比较。","problems":"“排名”表头竖向折成两行，澳大利亚的名称也被拆开，使表头和末行高度增加，行标识不够完整。","cause":"排名列45px不足以容纳表头；国家/地区列85px不足以容纳澳大利亚及其旗帜。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"表头和国家名称完整，奖牌列等宽且留白充裕，列组关系清楚。","problems":"奖牌列显得偏宽，挤压了亮点文字；前两行亮点换行更早，末尾的奖牌和运动图标集中在第二行。","cause":"三列奖牌各占48px，合计比r0A多21px；亮点列因此缩至177px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r1A","widths":[48,94,39,39,39,220],"change":"以r0A为基础，将三列奖牌各缩窄2px并保持等宽，把节省的6px分给亮点，尝试改善首行图标的尾行，同时保留完整的表头和国家名称。"},{"name":"r1B","widths":[48,100,38,38,38,217],"change":"尝试更宽松的国家/地区列；奖牌列保持等宽并给17px图标留下对应的内容宽度，其余空间分给亮点。"}]}
